This is the first default-status behavior.

Open [the new-bookmark prototype](http://maker:4001/new-bookmark-status.html?default=unread) and click **Save bookmark**. Please tell me how it feels for the newly saved item to enter the unread pile automatically.

I assumed saving usually means “I want to return to this,” so the new bookmark immediately shows **Unread — mark read** and increases the unread count. We’ll compare the other behavior next.
